Class GenericFileParser<T>

java.lang.Object
parser.GenericFileParser<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the type of object to parse the file into
public class GenericFileParser<T> extends Object
Generic file parser that converts delimited flat files into Java objects using annotations.

This class uses reflection to dynamically parse any flat file into POJOs without requiring custom parsing code for each file type. The POJO class must be annotated with FileSource to specify the delimiter, and fields must be annotated with Column to map to specific columns.

Supported Field Types:

  • String
  • int and Integer
  • double and Double
  • boolean and Boolean
  • LocalDate

Example Usage:

GenericFileParser<Transaction> parser = new GenericFileParser<>();
List<Transaction> transactions = parser.parse("transactions.txt", Transaction.class);

  • Method Details

    • parse

      public List<T> parse(String filePath, Class<T> clazz) throws IOException, ReflectiveOperationException
      Parses a delimited flat file into a list of objects of the specified type.

      This method reads the file line-by-line, splits each line using the delimiter specified in the @FileSource annotation, and populates object fields using the @Column annotations. Empty lines are skipped.

      Parameters:
      filePath - the path to the file to parse
      clazz - the class type to parse into (must have @FileSource annotation)
      Returns:
      a list of parsed objects
      Throws:
      IOException - if an I/O error occurs reading the file
      ReflectiveOperationException - if reflection operations fail (e.g., no default constructor)
      ParsingException - if the class is not annotated with @FileSource, or if data conversion fails
